holderQuote: She had gained a Skill too. She was Level 19 now, a [Worldly Princess], a rare class consolidation before Level 20, even. And her new Skill was called [Magnified Training].

“Krshia…about your gift to the other tribes. Well—my Skill from this morning is [Magnified Training]. Which does what you think. It’s a Skill for [Soldiers], [Students], you know? I was wondering…could I try using the spellbook?”
“She might make the cut, Jeiss. She’s got [Magnified Training].”
Yet there she went. Mivifa stared as Lyonette spread her arms.
effectQuote: [Magnified Training] to learn as fast as she could.
